inputs: actual turbine and substation layout, survey and available site constraints
outputs: engineer-reviewed collector site and interface evidence

steps.what: Establish actual collector design criteria, ratings, protection/interface assumptions and underground or overhead routing constraints
inputs: engineer-reviewed collector site and interface evidence
actual operating requirements and applicable project standards

steps.what: Design underground or overhead wind farm collector systems, selecting actual circuit arrangement, conductor routes, equipment and protection coordination approach
inputs: actual terrain, equipment data and network interfaces
outputs: engineer-selected collector design and calculation assumptions

steps.what: Author and check the complete collector drawings/model, actual parameter entry, engineering calculations and intended internal design revision
inputs: engineer-selected collector design and calculation assumptions
engineer-entered actual conductor/equipment values and site geometry
outputs: exact checked collector model/drawings and internal revision destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked wind collector design as its intended internal revision
inputs: exact checked collector model/drawings and internal revision destination

tasks.design: Configure current site/interface views and fixed equipment/property reuse in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the wind electrical design/GIS system. The engineer defines criteria and circuit/routing choices, enters actual parameters and checks the completed calculations and drawings before saving the exact internal revision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated site navigation and fixed equipment entry add design administration.
tasks.enabler_now: Native site views and electrical design libraries can reuse verified fixed properties.
tasks.still_hard: Routing, equipment ratings and protection depend on actual site and electrical assumptions.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve physical and electrical constraints and challenge model assumptions.

ambition.what: No autonomous construction release or network energisation.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; electrical/site-data owners validate access and property reuse

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native electrical design/GIS views and equipment libraries can reduce repeated handling while collector engineering decisions remain specialist work.

assumptions: Unmeasured collector design episode. Gross 20 x .10 + 24 x .10 = 4.4; upkeep 1.5; net 2.9 hours per 100.

Actual survey/layout and equipment records already exist from their accountable producers; engineer retrieves/reconciles them in s1 and enters actual design parameters in s4. Missing site facts require manual investigation, not inferred geometry.

Only navigation and fixed entry/layout change; all engineering interpretation, parameter validity and final checks stay. Existing electrical calculations and solver runtime already happen today and earn no saving.

Same-system save is 1 fully retained point, approximately zero today and no saving. Completed actual design check within s4 gates exact final version/destination; edits require recheck. No permit submission, equipment command or construction send is promised.
unknowns: Current native views and equipment-property reuse
research_questions: Which site and component fields are actually handled repeatedly after current design-tool configuration?

already_counted.description: Design criteria, collector choices and complete model/drawing authoring/check

incremental.description: Maintain site views and validate electrical library property mappings

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed collector design/calculations and internal destination checked in s4; edits invalidate check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 native handling scenario below 2.9% modeled net; no engineering or solver-runtime benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

inputs: loaded actual test-result rows and linked test references
actual original instrument/test-team records and acceptance criteria

steps.what: Write engineering findings, actual exceptions, interpretation and limitations for the wind collector test report
inputs: engineer-reconciled actual collector test evidence and unresolved exceptions
actual test objectives and acceptance criteria
outputs: engineer-authored actual test findings and limitations

steps.what: Write reports to document wind farm collector system test results by assembling actual result tables, references and authored findings, then check the complete final report and destination
inputs: engineer-reconciled actual collector test evidence and unresolved exceptions
engineer-authored actual test findings and limitations
actual report template and required internal record identity
outputs: exact complete checked collector test report and internal revision destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked collector-system test report in its intended internal report record
inputs: exact complete checked collector test report and internal revision destination
outputs: saved internal wind collector test report

tasks.design: Configure native import and report templates in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the collector test-reporting system, and {DOCS}. The engineer reconciles actual test records, writes every substantive finding and checks the completed assembled report before saving its exact internal revision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated export handling and result-table/report assembly add clerical effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native import/report mappings can reuse an existing stable test-export structure.
tasks.still_hard: Correct units, circuit identity, exceptions and technical conclusions require engineering review.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret what the actual test does and does not establish.

ambition.what: No autonomous acceptance, energisation permission or external report release.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; test/document owners approve export access and report fields

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native structured test imports and document templates can reduce result-table assembly without generating engineering conclusions.

assumptions: Unmeasured recurring structured-test-report episode. Gross 25 x .20 + 24 x .30 = 12.2; upkeep 2; net 10.2 hours per 100.

Actual instruments/test team already produce structured result exports during testing. Engineer loads/reconciles them in s1-s2; missing records, new formats or handwritten results require manual entry and no assumed gain.
Findings and limitations are actually authored in s3. Templates only assemble fixed values and supplied text; no LLM arithmetic, invented pass/fail result or free prose meaning judgment.
All final report checking remains in s4. Existing test execution and already configured imports earn no additional saving.

Same-system save 1 stays fully retained, approximately zero today with no saving. s4 checks completed final report/destination before s5; edits require recheck. The statement requires report writing, not an assumed free external send.
unknowns: Actual current re-keying and report assembly burden
research_questions: Which result rows are really retyped, and can native mappings preserve units, run identity and exceptions?

incremental.description: Maintain and test export/report mappings after instrument or template changes

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed collector test report, references and internal revision destination checked in s4; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 structured report-assembly scenario below 10.2% modeled net; no field-test or technical-judgment saving.
